title: 🎂 Birthday Message Wall (Enhancing Business Central’s HR)🎉
summary: A Birthday Message Wall extension adds human celebration features to Business Central's HR module, enabling automated company birthday greetings, peer-to-peer messages, birthday tracking, and dynamic role center headlines. It helps HR departments automate birthday management, allows employees to send personalized messages, and provides management with team interaction metrics.
key_points: Implements automated daily job queue processing to identify birthdays and send personalized company messages to employee inboxes
Enables employees to exchange birthday messages with colleagues through a two-click interface and 7-day visibility window
Stores birthday data via extended employee table with automatic calculations for next birthday date and days remaining
Integrates with Role Center headlines that dynamically display birthday context for each user
Provides HR analytics dashboard with birthday metrics and full audit trail of all celebrations

quotes.text: A work queue calculates which employees have birthdays that day, creates personalized company messages, and instantly posts them to the employee's message inbox.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the core automation mechanism that eliminates manual HR intervention
